rows.question: Why does Finance revenue differ from the sales dashboard?
rows.headline: Net Revenue: Gross sales minus discounts minus refunds, recognised when the order ships. Cancelled and unshipped orders are excluded. Refunds are attributed to the period of the original sale.

rows.question: How is churn rate calculated?
rows.headline: Customer Churn Rate: Share of customers active at the start of the period (ordered within their activity window) who were no longer active at the end of it. Activity windows are 90 days for Enterprise and Mid-Market, 180 for SMB and 365 for Consumer.

rows.question: What does active customer mean?
rows.headline: Active Customers: Customers with at least one non-cancelled order within their activity window before the period end. Windows are 90 days for Enterprise and Mid-Market, 180 days for SMB and 365 days for Consumer.

rows.question: What is our discount approval policy?
rows.headline: Standard discounts are up to 10 percent for Enterprise, 8 percent for Mid-Market and 5 percent for SMB. Any line discount above 15 percent requires approval from the regional sales director, and discounts above 25 percent require CFO approval.
retrieved: previous_findings.md › FIND-2023-07 — Q4 discount depth is planned

rows.question: When does our fiscal year start?
rows.headline: Halden's fiscal year starts on 1 February and is named after the calendar year in which it ends. FY2025 therefore runs from 1 February 2024 to 31 January 2025, and FY2026 runs from 1 February 2025 to 31 January 2026.
retrieved: previous_findings.md › FIND-2023-03 — January dip is seasonal

rows.question: How is CAC defined?
rows.headline: Customer Acquisition Cost: Paid marketing spend divided by new customers acquired through paid channels. Organic, referral and direct-sales acquisitions are excluded from both sides.
